sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: `/cdstub/browse` ("Top CD stubs"): the native "Added N years ago, last modified M years ago" info row's text was landing in the "Primary alias" column instead of "Comment" — extractMainColumn always appends MB-Name/Comment/Primary alias in that order, so Primary alias (not Comment) is the row's real last cell.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: `/cdstub/browse`: the same CD stub could appear twice in the consolidated table. This listing ranks by a live, constantly-changing lookup count with no stable secondary sort key, so two page fetches a few seconds apart can return heavily overlapping results (measured ~90% overlap between page 1 and page 2) — an upstream ranking artifact, not something sorting introduced (sorting only made the pre-existing, scattered duplicates collate together and become visible). Rows are now deduplicated by their Title link as they're fetched.
